title: CoreWeave credit default swaps hit distress levels as investors sour on AI debt
summary: Signs of distressed deepened in CoreWeave on Thursday.
title_en: CoreWeave Credit Default Swaps Hit Distress Levels as Investors Sour on AI Debt
title_zh: CoreWeave信用违约互换触及困境水平，投资者对AI债务态度转冷
summary_en: CoreWeave's credit default swaps reached distressed levels Thursday, signaling growing investor concern over AI-related debt and the financial health of the AI cloud provider.
summary_zh: 周四，CoreWeave的信用违约互换触及困境水平，表明投资者对AI相关债务及这家AI云服务商财务健康的担忧加剧。

title: Meta launches an open-weight AI model that runs on Macs
summary: Meta and Apple have teamed up for the launch of the social media giant's newest model, Muse Spark Open, which will run locally on Apple silicon.

title_zh: Meta推出可在Mac本地运行的开放权重AI模型

summary_zh: Meta与苹果合作推出Muse Spark Open开放权重AI模型，可在苹果芯片Mac上本地运行，无需依赖云端。

title: Nvidia, AMD, Dell sink in global tech rout on AI funding worries
summary: A sell-off in global technology hardware stocks deepened Thursday.
title_en: Nvidia, AMD, Dell Sink in Global Tech Rout on AI Funding Worries
title_zh: AI融资担忧引发全球科技股抛售，英伟达、AMD、戴尔股价下挫
summary_en: A sell-off in global technology hardware stocks deepened Thursday, with Nvidia, AMD, and Dell among the hardest hit amid growing concerns over AI funding.
summary_zh: 周四，全球科技硬件股抛售加剧，英伟达、AMD和戴尔等公司股价大幅下跌，市场对AI融资的担忧日益加剧。

title: NVIDIA Releases Nemotron 3.5 Super VL, a 120B Open Multimodal Agent Model
summary: NVIDIA released Nemotron 3.5 Super VL, an open 120B-parameter multimodal MoE model with 12B active parameters, 1M-token context and NVFP4 weights that run on 1 DGX Spark, plus 2 Bolt edge models. The post NVIDIA Releases Nemotron 3.5 Super VL, a 120B Open Multimodal Agent Model appeared first on MarkTechPost .
title_en: NVIDIA Releases Nemotron 3.5 Super VL, a 120B Open Multimodal Agent Model
title_zh: 英伟达发布Nemotron 3.5 Super VL：1200亿参数开源多模态智能体模型
summary_en: NVIDIA released Nemotron 3.5 Super VL, an open 120B-parameter multimodal MoE model with 12B active parameters, 1M-token context, and NVFP4 weights that run on one DGX Spark, plus two Bolt edge models.
summary_zh: 英伟达发布Nemotron 3.5 Super VL，这是一款1200亿参数的开源多模态MoE模型，激活参数120亿，支持100万token上下文，采用NVFP4权重可在单台DGX Spark上运行，同时推出两款Bolt边缘模型。

title: Bringing GPT-Rosalind to academic research labs

summary_zh: OpenAI推出Rosalind学术计划，为符合条件的学术实验室提供GPT-Rosalind的赞助访问权限及相关工具，以推动生命科学研究。

title: Anthropic is letting METR researchers look under the hood with employee-level access
summary: METR will publish its own assessments of Anthropic’s risks, incidents, and practices, and the frontier AI model maker has given up the right to block them.
title_en: Anthropic Grants METR Employee-Level Access for Independent Risk Assessments
title_zh: Anthropic授予METR员工级访问权限以进行独立风险评估
summary_en: Anthropic is giving METR researchers employee-level access to assess its risks, incidents, and practices. METR will publish independent assessments, and Anthropic has waived its right to block publication.
summary_zh: Anthropic允许METR研究人员以员工级权限评估其风险、事件和实践。METR将发布独立评估报告，Anthropic已放弃阻止发布的权利。

title: TSMC chip capacity is ‘fierce’ battleground for AI customers, amid record quarter

In an interview at TechCrunch Disrupt, Bluesky CEO Toni Schneider said […]
title_en: Bluesky's Attie AI tool now lets users build shareable mini-apps and games
title_zh: Bluesky的Attie AI工具现可让用户创建可分享的迷你应用和游戏
summary_en: Bluesky's Attie AI tool, initially for building custom feeds, now lets users create small social apps like games, polls, and dashboards that can be shared as standalone websites, CEO Toni Schneider announced at TechCrunch Disrupt.
summary_zh: Bluesky的Attie AI工具最初用于构建自定义信息流，现在允许用户创建游戏、投票和仪表板等小型社交应用，并可作为独立网站分享。CEO Toni Schneider在TechCrunch Disrupt上宣布了这一消息。
